chinese: 1) [U] determination to be successful, rich, powerful, etc. 抱负；雄心；野心
examples: e.g. She was intelligent but suffered from a lack of [[ambition]].；e.g. Earlier this year, he achieved his [[ambition]] of competing in the Olympic Games.

chinese: 2) [C] a strong desire to achieve sth. 追求；夙愿；理想
examples: e.g. She was intelligent but suffered from a lack of [[ambition]].；e.g. Earlier this year, he achieved his [[ambition]] of competing in the Olympic Games.

chinese: determined to be successful, rich, powerful, etc. 有抱负的；有雄心的；野心勃勃的
examples: e.g. She's extremely [[ambitious]] and intends to be running her own company by the time she's 30.

chinese: (also 'some day') at an unknown time in the future, esp. a long time in the future 将来会有一天；有朝一日
examples: e.g. He hopes, [[someday]], to have his own business.

chinese: in a way that shows no emotion when you are talking about sth. exciting, frightening, etc. 就事论事地；不带感情地；实事求是地
examples: e.g. To my surprise, he spoke about his divorce [[matter-of-factly]].

chinese: [U] the scientific study of living things 生物学
examples: e.g. Students might pursue a degree in [[biology]] as a path to medical school or a variety of professions.

chinese: find a satisfactory way of dealing with a problem or difficulty 解决（问题、困难）
examples: e.g. There weren't enough beds, but the matter was [[resolved]] by George sleeping on the sofa.

chinese: [U] books and stories about imaginary people and events 小说
examples: e.g. The book is a work of [[fiction]] and not intended as a historical account.

chinese: [C] (AmE) a student in the first year of high school or university （高中或大学的）一年级学生
examples: e.g. It is necessary for [[freshmen]] to get to know their new studying environment in university as soon as possible.

chinese: behave as if sth. is true when in fact you know it is not, in order to deceive people or for fun 假装；装作
examples: e.g. She [[pretended]] that she was not at home when we rang the bell.

chinese: 1) (~ for sth.; ~ to do sth.) needing or wanting sth. very much 非常需要···的；极其需要···的
examples: e.g. The healthcare industry is [[desperate]] for solutions to its business models.；e.g. I had no money left and was [[desperate]].

chinese: 2) willing to do anything to change a very bad situation, and not caring about danger （为了改变糟糕境遇而）不惜冒险的，拼命的，绝望的
examples: e.g. The healthcare industry is [[desperate]] for solutions to its business models.；e.g. I had no money left and was [[desperate]].

chinese: [C] (infml.) a friend 朋友；伙伴
examples: e.g. Bob and I have been great [[buddies]] for years.

chinese: amusing and interesting 使人愉快的；有趣的
examples: e.g. His books aren't particularly well-written, but they're always [[entertaining]].

chinese: showing or saying that you are sorry that sth. has happened, esp. because you feel guilty or embarrassed about it 道歉的；谢罪的；愧疚的
examples: e.g. She was [[apologetic]] about my injury.

chinese: succeed in achieving sth. after trying for a long time （通过长时间努力而）得到，获得，赢得
examples: e.g. More and more women are [[attaining]] positions of power.

chinese: possible to achieve, reach, or get 可以达到的；可以获得的
examples: e.g. We must make sure that we do not set ourselves goals that are not [[attainable]].

chinese: [U] the quality of trying to do sth. even when it is difficult 决心；坚韧；毅力
examples: e.g. He shows great [[determination]] to learn English.

chinese: accepting things as they are in fact and not making decisions based on unlikely hopes for the future 现实的；实际的；实事求是的
examples: e.g. Let's be [[realistic]] about this 一 I just can't afford to pay that much money.

chinese: [C, U] a thick tropical forest with many large plants growing very close together （热带）丛林
examples: e.g. We had to cut our way through dense [[jungle]].

chinese: certain to happen or to do sth. because a mysterious force is controlling events 命运决定的；命中注定的
examples: e.g. She says she was [[fated]] to become a writer.

chinese: 1) eager to go to new places and do exciting or dangerous things 喜欢冒险的；有冒险精神的
examples: e.g. I took an [[adventurous]] ski trip in Austria last year.；e.g. Warren is a very [[adventurous]] cook, always trying to make new dishes.

chinese: 2) not afraid of taking risks or trying new things 大胆创新的
examples: e.g. I took an [[adventurous]] ski trip in Austria last year.；e.g. Warren is a very [[adventurous]] cook, always trying to make new dishes.

chinese: sth. that is exotic seems unusual and interesting because it is related to a foreign country 异国风情的；外国情调的
examples: e.g. She likes traveling to all kinds of [[exotic]] locations.

chinese: [n.] 1) [C] (~ of) a group of similar things 一系列
examples: e.g. We've had a [[string]] of complaints about the program.；e.g. Her key hung on a [[string]] around her neck.；e.g. She had strung the shells on a silver chain.

chinese: [n.] 2) [C, U]（由几股合成的）线，细绳，带子
examples: e.g. We've had a [[string]] of complaints about the program.；e.g. Her key hung on a [[string]] around her neck.；e.g. She had strung the shells on a silver chain.

chinese:
[vt.]3)
(strung, strung) put things together onto a thread, chain, etc. 用（线、 链等）穿起来
examples: e.g. We've had a [[string]] of complaints about the program.；e.g. Her key hung on a [[string]] around her neck.；e.g. She had strung the shells on a silver chain.

chinese: [C, U] a state of disagreement or argument between people, groups, countries, etc. （意见等的）抵触，冲突，矛盾
examples: e.g. She found herself in [[conflict]] with her parents over her future career.

chinese: in a way that involves all your feelings, interest, etc. 全心全意地；全力以赴地
examples: e.g. I agree [[whole-heartedly]] with the mayor on this issue.

chinese: if one person does sth. single-mindedly, they have one clear aim and work very hard to achieve it 一心一意地；专心致志地
examples: e.g. His ability to concentrate [[single-mindedly]] on the most important thing leads to his success.

chinese: always wanting more food, money, power, possessions, etc. than you need 贪婪的；贪心的； 贪吃的；贪喝的
examples: e.g. He looked at the gold with [[greedy]] eyes.

chinese: a chaotic situation is one in which everything is happening in a confused way 混乱的； 毫无秩序的
examples: e.g. The traffic in the city is [[chaotic]] in the rush hour.

chinese: 1) if sb. /sth. is overdue, they should have arrived before now 迟到的；延误的
examples: e.g. If you're [[overdue]] for a vacation, you can prepare for an adventure instead of cancelling it.；e.g. These books are [[overdue]] and you should pay a fine.

chinese: 2) not done, paid, returned, etc. by the time expected 过期未完成的；过期未付的；过期未还的
examples: e.g. If you're [[overdue]] for a vacation, you can prepare for an adventure instead of cancelling it.；e.g. These books are [[overdue]] and you should pay a fine.

chinese: sb., esp. a child or young person, who is mature behaves in a sensible and reasonable way, as you would expect an adult to behave （尤指小孩或年轻人举止）成熟的，理智的，明白事理的
examples: e.g. We're [[mature]] enough to disagree on this issue but still respect each other.

chinese: give sb. a particular job or make them responsible for a particular person or thing 分配，分派，指派（任务）
examples: e.g. I've been [[assigned]] the task of looking after the new students.

chinese: [C] (BrE paediatrician)a doctor who deals with children and their illnesses 儿科医生
examples: e.g. He dreams of becoming a doctor, specifically a [[pediatrician]].

chinese: [C] a popular product, esp. a book, that many people buy 畅销产品；畅销书
examples: e.g. His new book went straight to No. 1 on the [[best-seller]] list.

chinese: (often used in negative sentences or questions) any longer 再也（不）；（不）再
examples: e.g. You're describing a world that just doesn't exist [[anymore]].

chinese: (strove, striven) (~ to do sth.; ~ for / after sth.) make a great effort to achieve sth. 努力；奋斗
examples: e.g. We encourage all members to [[strive]] for the highest standards.

chinese: (only before noun) extremely popular 畅销的
examples: e.g. It's almost every author's dream to become a [[best-selling]] author.

chinese: [C] a meeting held by a person or group at which they answer questions from people who write or present news reports 记者招待会；新闻发布会
examples: e.g. The football coach held a [[press conference]] to announce his retirement.

chinese: attractive or interesting 有吸引力的；有趣的
examples: e.g. The city offers an [[appealing]] combination of sporting and cultural events.

chinese: [C] 舌；舌头
[C, U] a feeling of sadness that makes you think there is no hope for the future 忧伤；沮丧；消沉
examples: e.g. She suffered from severe [[depression]] after losing her job.

chinese: 1) when sb. feels alone and unable to meet or speak to other people 孤独；孤单
examples: e.g. After all the visitors had left, she experienced a feeling of complete [[isolation]].；e.g. Because of its geographical [[isolation]], the area developed its own unique culture.

chinese: 2) when one group, person, or thing is separate from others 隔绝；孤立；分离
examples: e.g. After all the visitors had left, she experienced a feeling of complete [[isolation]].；e.g. Because of its geographical [[isolation]], the area developed its own unique culture.

chinese: [C] sb. who is paid to work for sb. else 受雇者；雇员
examples: e.g. e.g. Alibaba Group has more than 100,000 global [[employees]].

chinese: [C] sb. who studies and develops ideas about the nature and meaning of existence, truth, good and evil, etc. 哲学家
examples: e.g. Socrates and Plato are two famous Greek [[philosophers]] whose ideas are still influential today.

chinese: if a story, plan, etc. unfolds, it becomes clearer as you hear or learn more about it （使）（故事、计划等）展开；逐渐呈现；展示
examples: e.g. The scandal is still [[unfolding]], but there may be a solution soon.

chinese: [C] sb.'s general attitude, and the way in which they think about things and make decisions 思维模式
examples: e.g. It's quite difficult to change the [[mindset]] of the public and the press.

chinese: become smaller in size, importance, or value, or make sth. do this （使）降低；（使）减少
examples: e.g. The new project will [[lessen]] the effects of car pollution.

chinese: (only before noun) relating to your feelings or how you control them 情绪（上）的；情感（上）的
examples: e.g. Mothers are often the ones who provide [[emotional]] support for the family.

chinese: 1) (fml.) notice, see, or recognize sth. 察觉；注意到；发觉
examples: e.g. That morning, he [[perceived]] a change in his wife's mood.；e.g. Even as a young woman she had been [[perceived]] as a future chief executive.

chinese: 2) (written) understand or think of sb. / sth. in a particular way （以某种方式）看待，理解
examples: e.g. That morning, he [[perceived]] a change in his wife's mood.；e.g. Even as a young woman she had been [[perceived]] as a future chief executive.

chinese: extremely brave or determined, and admired by many people 英雄的；英勇的
examples: e.g. These doctors performed [[heroic]] work in difficult conditions.

chinese: always behaving in the same way or having the same attitudes, standards, etc. （行为、态度、标准等）一贯的，一致的
examples: e.g. He has been the team's most [[consistent]] player.

chinese: able to continue for a long time 可持续的
examples: e.g. That sort of extreme diet is not [[sustainable]] over a long period.

chinese: [U] when you are healthy and strong enough to do hard work or play sports 健壮；健康
examples: e.g. They're doing some regular exercise to improve their [[fitness]].

chinese: [U] the ability to use your imagination to produce new ideas, make things, etc. 独创性；创造性；创造力
examples: e.g. We should have an education system that lets children use their [[creativity]].

chinese: [U] a long race of about 42 kilometers or 26 miles 马拉松赛跑
examples: e.g. She ran her first [[marathon]] in just under three hours.

chinese: 1) used to emphasize that sth., esp. a large number, is actually true 的确；确实
examples: e.g. The Olympic Games were watched by [[literally]] billions of people around the world.；e.g. I said I felt like quitting, but I didn't mean it [[literally]].

chinese: 2) according to the most basic or original meaning of a word or expression 按照原意；根据字面意思
examples: e.g. The Olympic Games were watched by [[literally]] billions of people around the world.；e.g. I said I felt like quitting, but I didn't mean it [[literally]].

chinese: try to do or use too much of sth., causing problems, illness, or damage 把···做得过分；把···使用过头
examples: e.g. e.g . Be careful not to [[overextend]] yourself. You've been very ill.

chinese: (be obsessed with / by) if sb. / sth. obsesses you, you think or worry about them all the time and you cannot think about anything else 一 used to show disapproval 使痴迷；使迷恋；使心神不宁（含贬义）
examples: e.g. A lot of young girls are [[obsessed]] by their weight.

chinese: (only before noun) the maximum amount, quantity, speed, etc. is the largest that is possible or is allowed 最大量的；最大限度的；最大值的
examples: e.g. To get the [[maximum]] benefit, do the exercises slowly.

chinese: [C] a period of physical exercise, esp. as training for a sport 体育锻炼；训练
examples: e.g. She does a 20-minute [[workout]] every morning.

chinese: used to contrast sb. / sth. with another person or thing 与···不同
examples: e.g. [[Unlike]] most people in the office, I don't come to work by car.

chinese: 1) a situation that seems strange because it involves two ideas or qualities that are very different 自相矛盾（的情况）
examples: e.g. It is a [[paradox]] that in such a rich country there can be so much poverty.；e.g. The [[paradox]] is that fishermen would catch more fish if they fished less.

chinese: 2) a statement that seems impossible because it contains two opposing ideas that are both true 悖论；似非而是的说法
examples: e.g. It is a [[paradox]] that in such a rich country there can be so much poverty.；e.g. The [[paradox]] is that fishermen would catch more fish if they fished less.

chinese:
vi.
(~ well / badly, etc.) work or do sth. well, badly, etc. 表现得好 / 差等
examples: e.g. The company has been [[performing]] poorly over the past year.；e.g. I'd like to hear the music [[performed]] live.

chinese: v. do sth. to entertain people, for example by acting a play or playing a piece of music 表演；演出
examples: e.g. The company has been [[performing]] poorly over the past year.；e.g. I'd like to hear the music [[performed]] live.

chinese: 1) use a lot of time and effort trying to get sth. such as work or money 努力赢得；设法获得
examples: e.g. Top graduates from the university are [[chased]] by major companies.；e.g. The dogs saw him running and [[chased]] him.

chinese: 2) quickly follow sb. / sth. in order to catch them 追逐；追赶；追捕
examples: e.g. Top graduates from the university are [[chased]] by major companies.；e.g. The dogs saw him running and [[chased]] him.

chinese: 1) sb. who is grounded understands their own character and knows what is really important 对自己有清醒认识的
examples: e.g. Mary says that she knows what she really wants because her family always keeps her [[grounded]].；e.g. Charles can always keep himself [[grounded]], even when he runs into difficulty.

chinese: 2）reasonable and in control of your emotions, even when this is difficult 理性的；有理智的；克制的
examples: e.g. Mary says that she knows what she really wants because her family always keeps her [[grounded]].；e.g. Charles can always keep himself [[grounded]], even when he runs into difficulty.

chinese: producing or achieving a lot 多产的；丰饶的；富有成效的
examples: e.g. We had a very [[productive]] meeting 一 I felt we sorted out a lot of problems.

chinese: [sing.] the set of ideas and moral attitudes that are typical of a particular group （某团体的）精神特质，道德意识
examples: e.g. It is a community in which people lived according to an [[ethos]] of sharing and caring.

chinese: (infml.) if sth. is yours for the asking, you can have it if you want it 某人只要提出要求（就可以得到）
examples: e.g. A good deal of extra support is hers for the asking.

chinese: have great success 大获成功
examples: e.g. I wasn't expecting it to work, but I [[hit it big]] when I tried the new approach.

chinese: (spoken) used when giving your personal opinion or admitting sth. 老实说；实话对你讲
examples: e.g. [[To tell the truth]], I don't really like her.

chinese: not take sb. / sth. with you when you leave a place 忘记带走；留下
examples: e.g. He departed for the United States, leaving the children behind with his mother.

chinese: relax and make no effort to get involved in sth. or influence what happens 不采取行动；袖手旁观
examples: e.g. Don't just [[sit back]] and wait for new business to come to you.

chinese: used for saying that there is more than one reason for sth. 由于这样或那样的原因
examples: e.g. His travel articles are always, [[for one reason or another]], fascinating.

chinese: (infml.) take an opportunity, accept an invitation, etc. immediately 抓住（机会）；立即接受（邀请等）
examples: e.g. This is our chance to grab at this new market.

chinese: accept an unpleasant or sad situation and no longer feel upset or angry about it 与某事妥协，对某事让步；接受（令人不快或悲伤的现实）
examples: e.g. It's hard for the couple to [[come to terms with]] the fact that they will never have children.

chinese: prevent sb. / sth. from making progress 阻碍某人 / 某事发展
examples: e.g. Do you think that mixed-ability teaching holds the brighter children back?

chinese: (infml.) if a name or phrase rolls or trips off your tongue, it is easy or pleasant to say （某个名字或短语）顺口
examples: e.g. Their names [[roll]] off the tongue very easily.

chinese: be in a state of physical or mental exhaustion caused by overwork or stress 感到精疲力竭
examples: e.g. He was burned out by the time he was 21 and retired from the sport.

chinese: the present time 现时
examples: e.g. To be able to live fully in [[the here and now]], one must first learn how to honor the past.

chinese: fail to win or achieve sth. 未能赢取；未能获得
examples: e.g. We're so close to getting the job done, but we keep coming up short.

chinese: increase by small amounts until there is a large total 积累；积少成多
examples: e.g. When you're feeding a family of six the bills soon [[add up]].

chinese: combine things in order to make sth. that is complete, good, useful, etc. 把···拼在一起
examples: e.g. They [[string together]] image after image until the documentary is completed.

chinese: (fml.) before 在···以前
examples: e.g. All the arrangements should be completed [[prior to]] your departure.

chinese: if you are at peace, you do not feel angry, unhappy, etc. 心平气和的
examples: e.g. For the first time in months, she felt calm and [[at peace]] with the world.

chinese: used to say that sth. is completely different from what has just been said 正好 / 完全相反
examples: e.g. I didn't feel sleepy at all 一 [[just the opposite]], in fact.

chinese: be the opposite of 违背某事；与某事背道而驰
examples: e.g. The governor's newest policy seems to be [[running]] counter to everything he promised during his election campaign.
